description: Ανανεώσιμες πηγές ενέργειας is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ανεξάρτητος Διαχειριστής Μεταφοράς Ηλεκτρικής Ενέργειας (ΑΔΜΗΕ). Energy produced by renewable energy sources in Greece, in megawatt-hours. Coverage: Ανεξάρτητος Διαχειριστής Μεταφοράς Ηλεκτρικής Ενέργειας (ΑΔΜΗΕ). The portal shows the English title as "Renewable Energy Sources" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ανεξάρτητος Διαχειριστής Μεταφοράς Ηλεκτρικής Ενέργειας (ΑΔΜΗΕ). Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, data.gov.gr. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-03-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
